days.label: Today
days.note: Long-period S swell (14s) peaks — big energy (~1255 kJ) but dead straight south. Light WNW offshore 6–9am is the clean window; ENE onshore from noon. Curl Curl S end best; Dee Why wraps poorly.
days.surfline_text: Light N to offshore winds in the morning for cleanest window of the day. Plenty of size at the south exposed breaks from long period S swell - it might be a bit straight though - find a good bank or bit of reef. More easy going at other spots but long period swell should get into most breaks.  Similar size to slightly easing into the afternoon, but NE'lies expected to pick up - south facing spots cleanest.
